scenario.job_to_be_done: Stop using time-bounded evidence exactly when its authorization deadline elapses, even before the background transition runs; retract every dependent conclusion, rebuild relationship memory, and renew only as reviewable evidence.

proofs.case: use-time enforcement before the background sweep
observations: The stored receipt still said authorized immediately after the deadline, proving the background transition had not yet run.
The resource API nevertheless projected the effective state as expired and returned no locator, fragments, claims, or evidence counts.
Chat rejected the still-published baseline Wiki with WIKI_SOURCE_AUTHORIZATION_STALE instead of assembling context from elapsed evidence.
Wiki compilation, research, claim decisions, proposal creation, identity-handle matching, derived-source creation, and evidence review all apply the deadline at use time.
The source lifecycle sweep recorded an expire decision with transition_actor system and no decided_by_user_id.
The matching audit event also had no recruiter actor.
The transition retracted one confirmed current-role state and reopened its exact source claim.
The baseline Wiki was superseded and the automatically compiled replacement had zero dependencies on the expired resource.
The same transition returns confirmed identity handles to proposed review and revokes unexecuted dependent actions and approvals.
Renewal changed the prior state from expired to authorized and set a new independent authorization deadline.
The evidence fragment returned as proposed and the claim returned as pending.
No prior approval, action, fact, or execution authority was restored.

A second source was renewed directly from its effective expired UI state before the periodic sweep; the request first recorded a system expiration and then completed the recruiter renewal without a stale-version dead end.
The ephemeral raw source was already purged while reviewed evidence remained usable until its independent authorization deadline.
Raw purge did not retract the reviewed evidence.
Authorization expiry retracted the evidence and its derivatives without claiming that the already purged original asset was deleted again.
The fixture-beta account received a 404 when requesting the fixture-alpha governed resource.
No cross-account resource metadata, expiration state, evidence, or claim proposal was disclosed.

product_surface.resource_ledger: Authorized sources can show their deadline; elapsed sources say authorization expired rather than overloading revoked or processing state.
product_surface.resource_detail: Expired detail is redacted and offers Renew access as a distinct operation from Delete source and Wrong person.
product_surface.renewal: The recruiter records a reason and can set a new authorization deadline. Copy explicitly separates evidence authorization from original-file retention.
product_surface.agent_history: Automatic expiration is a system-authored, relationship-scoped operation; renewal is recruiter-authored.

boundary_checks.human_authority: The system may enforce a previously supplied deadline but cannot invent or extend permission. Renewal still requires a human reason and optimistic version guard.
boundary_checks.external_effects: Proposed, approved, and failed future actions are revoked. Completed, executing, or unknown effects are counted for follow-up and never represented as undone.
boundary_checks.retry: The automatic transition uses a deterministic deadline-based idempotency key; manual renewal keeps its own caller idempotency key.
boundary_checks.lineage: Discovered sources inherit the parent authorization deadline and cannot be created from an effectively expired parent.

verification.runtime_result: All use-time, sweep, recompilation, retraction, renewal, and second-account assertions passed.
verification.database_readback: Decision, audit actor, state, claim, receipt, snapshot, and dependency rows matched the API result.

limitations: The proof is local and synthetic; it does not establish legal consent sufficiency, recruiter adoption, or commercial value.
The periodic worker currently runs in the backend process. Production deployment still needs a durable scheduler/queue and overdue-on-startup operational proof.
The Web has not yet demonstrated a nonzero completed or unknown external-effect follow-up warning.
No proactive pre-expiry Today brief or team handoff notification has been field-tested.
